pages.text: Biotech animal machines use captured mobs as items. Place a Net Trap on the ground and let a capturable mob step on it. The trap is consumed and the mob becomes an item that preserves safe gameplay state and can later be released.$(br)$(br)Vanilla land animals, land birds and bees, frogs, turtles, and Nether land animals are supported. Newer versions also include their newer animals. Fully aquatic animals are excluded.$(br)$(br)Default captured animals are available in the Biotech creative tab. Hover a captured item to compare its colors, genes, health, speed, jump strength, and other traits.

Cows, chickens, pigs, sheep, and rabbits keep their legacy Biotech item forms for recipe/world compatibility. Other supported mobs use the generic Captured Animal item, whose tooltip identifies the stored entity type.$(br)$(br)Pack makers can extend capture support with the $(code)biotech:capturable$() entity-type tag. Only animal types that Minecraft can recreate are accepted; invalid entries are ignored safely. A captured mob still needs a matching machine recipe before a Biotech machine can process it.
